risks.title: Construction Lending Risk
risks.score_rationale: Construction loans are subject to losses due to project delays, cost overruns, or sales difficulties in the California real estate market
risks.summary: Construction loans carry elevated risk due to potential project delays, unforeseen cost increases, or market sales challenges

risks.title: Real Estate Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Decline in real estate values and cash flows can result in loan losses and asset impairments held by the bank
risks.summary: Declines in real estate values and cash flows may lead to loan losses and reduced collateral values for the bank's portfolio

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk of borrower defaults and resulting loan losses, particularly in construction and real estate segments
risks.summary: Borrower defaults can result in significant loan losses across the portfolio

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk of insufficient liquidity to meet deposit withdrawals or credit demands in stressed market conditions
risks.summary: Inadequate liquidity may impair the bank's ability to meet deposit withdrawals and fulfill credit requests

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in banking regulations by DFPI, FDIC, or federal authorities may increase compliance costs and restrict operations
risks.summary: Regulatory changes may increase compliance costs and affect the bank's operational flexibility

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in financial markets can result in investment losses and impact portfolio valuations
risks.summary: Market volatility may result in losses on securities and investment holdings

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.score_rationale: Increased competition from larger banks and fintech firms may erode market share in served communities
risks.summary: Competitive pressures may result in loss of market share and margin compression

fr.activity: Hanmi Financial Corporation est une banque communautaire qui sert les communautés coréennes-américaines et pluriculturelles dans neuf états des États-Unis.
fr.products: Les principaux produits de Hanmi Financial Corporation incluent des prêts hypothécaires, des prêts personnels et des services de gestion des finances.
fr.customers: Les principaux clients de Hanmi Financial Corporation sont les particuliers et les petites entreprises de la communauté coréenne-américaine.
fr.edge: Hanmi Financial Corporation est unique en raison de sa forte présence dans les communautés coréennes-américaines, ce qui lui permet de mieux comprendre les besoins de ses clients.

en.activity: Hanmi Financial Corporation is a community bank serving Korean-American and multi-ethnic communities across nine US states.
en.products: Hanmi Financial Corporation's main products include mortgage loans, personal loans, and financial management services.
en.customers: Hanmi Financial Corporation's main customers are individual and small business members of the Korean-American community.
en.edge: Hanmi Financial Corporation is unique due to its strong presence in Korean-American communities, allowing it to better understand its customers' needs.

de.activity: Hanmi Financial Corporation ist eine Gemeinschaftsbank, die koreanisch-amerikanische und vielsprachige Gemeinschaften in neun US-Bundesstaaten bedient.
de.products: Die Hauptprodukte von Hanmi Financial Corporation umfassen Hypothekendarlehen, Personalkredite und Finanzmanagementdienste.
de.customers: Die Hauptkunden von Hanmi Financial Corporation sind individuelle und kleine Unternehmen der koreanisch-amerikanischen Gemeinschaft.
de.edge: Hanmi Financial Corporation ist einzigartig aufgrund seiner starken Präsenz in den koreanisch-amerikanischen Gemeinschaften, was es ermöglicht, die Bedürfnisse seiner Kunden besser zu verstehen.

fr.positioning: Hanmi Financial Corporation est une banque communautaire spécialisée dans le service des communautés coréennes-américaines, avec une présence forte dans neuf états des États-Unis.
fr.tech_products: Hanmi Financial Corporation utilise des systèmes de gestion des risques avancés pour fournir des prêts hypothécaires et personnels à ses clients.
fr.moat: Hanmi Financial Corporation possède une forte présence dans les communautés coréennes-américaines, ce qui lui permet de mieux comprendre les besoins de ses clients et de fournir des services personnalisés.
fr.risks: L'une des faiblesses de Hanmi Financial Corporation est sa dépendance aux prêts hypothécaires, qui peuvent être affectés par les fluctuations du marché immobilier.

en.positioning: Hanmi Financial Corporation is a community bank specializing in serving Korean-American communities, with a strong presence in nine US states.
en.tech_products: Hanmi Financial Corporation uses advanced risk management systems to provide mortgage and personal loans to its customers.
en.moat: Hanmi Financial Corporation has a strong presence in Korean-American communities, allowing it to better understand its customers' needs and provide customized services.
en.risks: One of Hanmi Financial Corporation's weaknesses is its dependence on mortgage loans, which can be affected by fluctuations in the housing market.

de.positioning: Hanmi Financial Corporation ist eine Gemeinschaftsbank, die sich auf den Service von koreanisch-amerikanischen Gemeinschaften spezialisiert hat, mit einer starken Präsenz in neun US-Bundesstaaten.
de.tech_products: Hanmi Financial Corporation verwendet fortschrittliche Risikomanagement-Systeme, um Hypothekendarlehen und Personalkredite an seine Kunden zu liefern.
de.moat: Hanmi Financial Corporation hat eine starke Präsenz in koreanisch-amerikanischen Gemeinschaften, was es ermöglicht, die Bedürfnisse seiner Kunden besser zu verstehen und personalisierte Dienstleistungen anzubieten.
de.risks: Eine der Schwächen von Hanmi Financial Corporation ist ihre Abhängigkeit von Hypothekendarlehen, die durch Schwankungen im Wohnungsmarkt beeinflusst werden können.
